rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors (Vision Pro, Leap Motion) while Symphony Creative Studio is building generative AI tooling at scale for creators and advertisers on TikTok. There's a potential conversation around how next-generation AI interfaces—whether spatial computing or video generation—reshape how content and creative tools reach users, and whether hardware innovation could enhance or complement AI-powered creative workflows.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Symphony Creative Studio — you're both working at the intersection of generative AI and end-user interfaces, and might find useful perspectives on how hardware and software innovations in AI tooling reach creators.
